## Summary and scope

What changes, why, and which exact core/companion profile does it affect?
Link the relevant requirement, issue or claim-ledger entry.

## Compatibility and evidence

- Current behavior and proposed behavior:
- Changed wire fields, schemas, defaults, canonical bytes or authority boundaries:
- Migration/rejection behavior for older versions:
- Exact commands, environment and results (including failures/skips):
- Independent reproduction, if actually performed:
- Remaining experimental, planned or untested behavior:

## Review checklist

- [ ] Fixtures, output and screenshots are synthetic and contain no secrets or private data.
- [ ] Specification, implementation, schema, vectors and site mirrors agree where affected.
- [ ] Added positive and negative coverage; passing schemas are not presented as behavioral conformance.
- [ ] Updated CHANGELOG.md Unreleased and docs/CLAIM-EVIDENCE.md for material claims.
- [ ] Followed CONTRIBUTING.md checks and LICENSING.md without changing historical release evidence.
- [ ] No unsupported adoption, production-readiness, outside-review or certification claims.
- [ ] Any release, tag or deployment is a separate explicitly approved action.

For a suspected vulnerability, do not submit a public PR or put exploit details
here. Use https://github.com/sierracatalina/context-layer/security/advisories/new
and the checklist in .github/SECURITY_REPORT_TEMPLATE.md. If private reporting is
unavailable, wait for a private channel; never use a public issue as a fallback.
